title: The first grave dug in the green acre
summary: Beitris Bhàn helps dig the first grave in the stony field beyond Achadh dhomhain's spoil-heaps, on a day the camp's own grave-diggers are themselves too sick to work. Within weeks the whole camp is calling the field an Acair Uaine without anyone having named it so on purpose.

title: Sìne Ruadh orders the huts of Àth ghlas burned
summary: The custodian of Àth ghlas, Sìne Ruadh, orders every hut where a death has occurred burned to the ground with its bedding before the next nightfall, over the Company agent's written protest at the loss of its property. She burns nine huts before the summer ends.

title: The clerk leaves a line blank after the twenty-sixth settlement
summary: The custodian's clerk who keeps the roll of settlements with cases of the Green Death leaves a blank line after the twenty-sixth name. It is still blank when a different hand takes up the roll the following spring, and no twenty-seventh name is ever entered in it.

title: Nathaniel Bright opens his table of weighings
summary: At Muileann chrom, Nathaniel Bright begins keeping a ruled black-bound book of the lungs he weighs from the Green Death's dead, with the custodians' leave and a custodian standing by at each opening. Anne Colby brings her own sick-house tally to set beside it that winter.

title: Walter Crane walks the sick-rows at Achadh dhomhain
summary: Commissioner Crane walks the worst of the sickness's second summer at Achadh dhomhain and does not walk faster past the bad huts than the ordinary ones, a thing the custodians and Beitris Bhàn both note and remember afterward in his favour.

title: Bright's table breaks off mid-row
summary: Nathaniel Bright falls ill in the third season of his study. His last entry stops after the weight of a dead man's lung, with the column for the dust in it left empty and the pen, by the mark it leaves, set down and never taken up again.

title: Anne Colby comes to Beitris Bhàn's door
summary: Anne Colby, unsent by the Mission and unasked by any custodian, comes to Achadh dhomhain to learn from the layer-out Beitris Bhàn what her own hands have taught her of the Green Death. The two begin washing the camp's dead together, a custom the camp comes to call An Dithis a Nigh Còmhla.

title: Nathaniel Bright dies at Muileann chrom
summary: Nathaniel Bright dies at Muileann chrom of the same sickness he had spent three seasons weighing in other men's lungs, and is buried by the Mission apart from the green acre and the field at Cnoc naomh. His book is filed at the Residency and never taken up by any physician after him.

title: George Tolley's quarantine at Caol mhin
summary: The new Commissioner, George Tolley, sets a quarantine station at Caol mhin holding every ship from an Tìr Thall offshore until its crew is looked over. It is the one order of his rule the custodians approve without reservation and say so in writing.

title: Beitris Bhàn nails a feather over her own door
summary: After laying out the fortieth body of the season, Beitris Bhàn nails a hawk's feather above her own door at Achadh dhomhain. The overseer's boy finds it and reports his father, and she pays the week's pay it costs her and nails up another within the month.
